request.prompt:
Independent regression lane for full-autopilot PR #73. The PR adds `removeTodo(id)`; requested behavior: remove one todo by ID and return true iff it existed. The exact current PR base/trunk is `fa50322ec63e863cf9af7b2bda769bff405a6aa9`; exact PR head is `d887b0ba7989303adda04703658f4d1090e1a82d`.

Check out trunk at the exact base SHA detached and prove it. Run `bun test` and `bun run typecheck` on trunk. Verify and explicitly record whether trunk has a `removeTodo` export (it is expected not to). Do not pretend trunk can run the new operation if absent. If absent, gate the feature contract on the PR head by reading the diff/source and state that the live PR lane separately must prove it, then run a small direct baseline store scenario on trunk (add/list/get/identity) to establish the pre-change end state. Do not edit tracked files, commit, push, or change PR metadata. Return `PASS`, `ISSUES`, or `BLOCKED`, exact base SHA, all commands/results, the feature-presence fact, and any concrete regression finding.
